ops.text: Kubient shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Kubient shall provide Customer with certificates of insurance upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a short insurance covenant as none appears in the Agreement and Kubient collects and stores visitor data for us: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber of USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. We have dropped the one-year post-termination coverage tail; if the limits are an issue, we can discuss E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new General Provisions subsection (j)

mappings.element: Commercial general liability of USD 1M per occurrence.
Commercial general liability of USD 2M aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2M.
Cyber and privacy insurance of USD 5M for vendors processing Customer Data.
Workers' compensation as required by law.
